units.source_text: 下山时，我和荣吉有意殿后，一边慢悠悠地聊天，一边踏上归程。

en.t: As we went down the mountain, Eikichi and I deliberately stayed behind, chatting leisurely as we started on the way back.

units.source_text: 刚走了两百多米，舞女从下面跑了上来。

en.t: We had gone only a little more than two hundred meters when the dancing girl came running up from below.
